zh-CN.name: REA MCP
zh-CN.summary: REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务：分析本地二进制、JavaScript、托管代码与浏览器；需兼容 Node.js，分析引擎按任务另行配置。
zh-CN.description: 固定 rea-agents@6.8.0 的本地 stdio 服务，CLI 与 MCP 共用一个发布包，无独立桌面 GUI。Node.js 要求 ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1，因此需要 DesireCore 10.0.201 及以上（随包 Node.js 26.13.0）。服务登记不自动安装 Ghidra、Hopper、IDA、JEB、Java、浏览器或 Android 工具；可选依赖 Frida 在关闭安装脚本时不会下载原生绑定；商用引擎需单独许可。仅分析获授权目标，运行、附加调试、修改文件及设备操作需明确授权。包内记录的 MCP 目录有 229 项工具。6.4.0 曾在 macOS 验证无目标启动、握手和工具列表；6.8.0 只复核了制品、npm 来源证明与许可，未运行。Windows/Linux 与具体分析任务未实测。条目为独立社区收录，不代表上游背书或完整安全审计。

en-US.name: REA MCP
en-US.summary: REA reverse-engineering MCP service for local binaries, JavaScript, managed code and browsers; requires compatible Node.js and task-specific analysis providers.
en-US.description: Local stdio service pinned to rea-agents@6.8.0. CLI and MCP share one release package; there is no standalone desktop GUI. Requires Node.js ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1, so DesireCore 10.0.201 or later (bundling Node.js 26.13.0) is required. Listing does not install Ghidra, Hopper, IDA, JEB, Java, browsers or Android tools, and the optional Frida dependency is fetched without its native binding because lifecycle scripts are disabled; commercial engines require separate licenses. Analyze authorized targets only; execution, debugger attachment, file mutation and device actions require explicit authorization. The package records a 229-tool MCP catalog. Target-free startup, handshake and tool listing were verified for 6.4.0 on macOS; 6.8.0 was reviewed for artifacts, npm provenance and licenses only and was not executed. Windows/Linux and actual analyses were not exercised. Independent community listing, without upstream endorsement or a complete security audit.
